name: connect-knocks
description: /connect knocks opens the knock screen (issue #123): a missed knock kept on this device shows the knocker's device name, device ID and text, never its key or a relay: address; the blocked route, the empty contacts list and who may knock show; offline says knocks cannot reach this device; Esc closes it. The missed knock and settings are seeded into knocks.json (rewritten every run) because a spec has no second device or relay.

setup.description: throwaway HOME (first-run network guide already seen) with a workspace on an offline network and one missed knock
setup.command: R=$(pwd); H="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/kollab-spec-connect-knocks"; mkdir -p "$H/.kollab" "$H/ws"; touch "$H/.kollab/connect-guide-seen"; printf '%s' '{"kollabor":{"llm":{"active_profile":"openai-test","profiles":{"openai-test":{"provider":"openai","model":"gpt-5.5","base_url":"https://api.openai.com/v1","api_key":"sk-test-dummy","supports_tools":true}}}},"plugins":{"hub":{"enabled":true}}}' > "$H/.kollab/config.json"; ln -sfn "$R/plugins" "$H/ws/plugins"; cd "$H/ws" && HOME="$H" PYTHONPATH="$R" "$R/.venv/bin/python" -c "import json, os; from plugins.hub.project_scope import resolve_project_root as root; from plugins.hub.relay_state import RelayStateStore as Store; s = Store(root(), None); s.state.origin = 'https://relay.invalid'; s.state.device_name = 'laptop-kollab'; s.state.network_name = 'laptop-kollab-net'; s.save(); d = {'v': 1, 'mode': 'contacts', 'mode_until': 0, 'blocked': {'0123456789abcdef': 'spam-box'}, 'contacts': {}, 'muted': {}, 'missed': [{'id': 'c' * 32, 'key': 'ab12' + '0' * 56 + 'ef01', 'device': 'ana-laptop', 'text': 'Ana from Acme. Can we talk about the API?', 'at': 1790000000}]}; p = s.path / 'knocks.json'; p.write_text(json.dumps(d)); os.chmod(p, 0o600)"
